tool.name: gtf2ribosomalintervallist
tool.description: Convert bam files to bedgraph file
tool.command: bash -c "grep '\#\#sequence-region' ${input_gff} | awk -v OFS=' ' '{print $2,$4}' | sed 's/ / LN:/' | sed 's/^/@SQ SN:/' > ${TMPDIR}/header.txt ; grep rRNA ${input_gtf} | grep ' gene ' | cut -f 1,4,5,7,9 > ${TMPDIR}/pre.txt ; cut -f 1,2,3,4 ${TMPDIR}/pre.txt > ${TMPDIR}/part1.txt ; grep -o -e 'gene_id[ \"A-Za-z0-9]*' ${TMPDIR}/pre.txt | sed 's/gene_id//' | tr -d ' ' | tr -d '\"' > ${TMPDIR}/part2.txt ; echo '@HD VN:1.0 SO:unsorted' > ${TMPDIR}/output.txt ; cat ${TMPDIR}/header.txt >> ${TMPDIR}/output.txt ; paste ${TMPDIR}/part1.txt ${TMPDIR}/part2.txt >> ${TMPDIR}/output.txt ; cp ${TMPDIR}/output.txt ${output} ; rm ${TMPDIR}/header.txt ${TMPDIR}/output.txt ${TMPDIR}/part1.txt ${TMPDIR}/part2.txt ${TMPDIR}/pre.txt"
